# oblique_listing_role_policy (Resource)

A ListingRolePolicy defines a policy for auto-approved access to a role. Right now it is just groups/teams that can be designated as eligible groups, this may expand in the future. A role can have multiple ListingRolePolicies, each ListingRolePolicy corresponds to one group/team and one expiry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Listing role policies control how members of a team can request a listing
# role. Each policy binds a team to a role with per-team rules for default
# expiry, required justification, and similar request behavior.
#
# Use different policies to give different teams different access behaviors
# for the same role (e.g. contractors get shorter expiries than employees).
#
# A listing_role_policy is scoped to its parent role (and the role to its
# listing), so the example manages the whole chain together. The teams the
# policies apply to are external — they're looked up via data sources.
resource "oblique_listing" "figma" {
  display_name = "Figma"
  visibility   = "PUBLIC"
}

resource "oblique_listing_role" "figma_user" {
  parent       = oblique_listing.figma.name
  display_name = "Viewer"
  priority     = 0
}

resource "oblique_listing_role" "figma_editor" {
  parent       = oblique_listing.figma.name
  display_name = "Editor"
  priority     = 1
}

data "oblique_team" "engineering" {
  name = "teams/engineering"
}

data "oblique_team" "product" {
  name = "teams/product"
}

resource "oblique_listing_role_policy" "figma_engineer_policy" {
  parent         = oblique_listing_role.figma_user.name
  team           = data.oblique_team.engineering.name
  default_expiry = "604800s" # 7 days
}

resource "oblique_listing_role_policy" "figma_product_policy" {
  parent                 = oblique_listing_role.figma_editor.name
  team                   = data.oblique_team.product.name
  default_expiry         = "7776000s" # 90 days
  justification_required = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_expiry` (String) If present, users can only self-serve access to a role for this duration. Otherwise, users can select how long they would like to have access to the role.
- `group` (String)
- `justification_prompt` (String) Admins can specify a custom question for the justification field to show users.
- `justification_required` (Boolean) If true, users will be required to provide a justification when requesting auto-approved access. The justification response will be stored on the resulting request.
- `name` (String) Name of the policy of the form "listings/{listing}/roles/{role}/policies/{listing_role_policy}"
- `parent` (String) The parent of the resource.
- `team` (String)

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) The time when this policy was created.
- `delete_time` (String) ListingRolePolicies can only be soft-deleted to preserve logs and history. If this field is present, the policy has been deleted and won't be returned in lists.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'. This exists to enable Terraform import.
- `management` (Attributes) How this policy is managed. Inherited from the grandparent listing (via the parent role): policies under a Terraform-managed listing are themselves Terraform managed and can only be created, updated, or deleted through the Terraform provider; manage the listing to change this. Omitted from responses when the listing is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `update_time` (String) The time when this policy was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the resource is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce TERRAFORM; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
